description: This file defines the 'WeightClass' controller class within the OpenCart admin localisation namespace. It handles CRUD operations for weight classes, including listing, form handling for add/edit, and saving data. The class interacts with models, manages URLs, breadcrumbs, localization, permissions, and pagination.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Controller for managing weight classes in the admin localisation section of OpenCart. It provides methods for listing, adding, editing, and deleting weight classes, with support for pagination, localization, and permission checks.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the list of weight classes, manages sorting, pagination, and breadcrumb setup.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX call or page request to load the list of weight classes, returning the view with data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the list of weight classes based on sorting, ordering, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a weight class, populating existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission for creating or updating a weight class, including permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected weight classes, validating permissions and cleaning up associated products.
